output.answer: As of today, AWS's top technology executive is Dr. Matt Wood, who holds the title of Chief AI & Technology Officer — Amazon's own news site bills him as the 'AWS CTO.' Wood returned to AWS in 2026 (after a ~15-year earlier career there, most recently at PwC) and, per Amazon's Sept. 17, 2026 announcement, led the AWS Global Meeting as 'AWS Chief AI and Technology Officer.' He succeeded Dr. Werner Vogels, the long-time Amazon CTO who gave his final re:Invent closing keynote in December 2025 while remaining at Amazon. One caveat: a November 5, 2026 report says Pedram Rezaei, a 20-year Microsoft veteran, joined AWS in October 2026 'to become CTO,' but Rezaei's own LinkedIn lists him as 'Distinguished Engineer / VP at AWS' with a product focus (Amazon Quick and Kiro), so that report appears to overstate a product-scoped role; the cited evidence supports Wood as AWS's chief technology officer.
caveats: An IT Brew report (Nov. 5, 2026) states Pedram Rezaei joined AWS in October 2026 'to become CTO'; however, Rezaei's own LinkedIn profile lists him as 'Distinguished Engineer / VP at Amazon Web Services (AWS),' and the announcement memo describes his work as focused on the Amazon Quick and Kiro products under Swami Sivasubramanian — so his title as a company-wide CTO is unconfirmed and this role may be product-scoped.

AWS uses the title 'Chief AI & Technology Officer' rather than a classic 'CTO' for Wood; Amazon's news site headlines him as the 'AWS CTO,' but the precise official title as of Nov. 11, 2026 is Chief AI and Technology Officer.

Third-party pages (e.g., The Information org chart, older blog posts) still list Werner Vogels as VP & CTO of Amazon; these are outdated relative to the 2026 sources showing Wood in the technology chief role.

output.question: Who is AWS's CTO?

key_facts.fact: AWS's technology chief is Matt Wood, titled 'Chief AI and Technology Officer'; he presented as such at the AWS Global Meeting on Sept. 17, 2026, per Amazon's official news site, which headlines him as the 'AWS CTO.'

Matt Wood's own LinkedIn profile states: 'Chief AI & Technology Officer, AWS' and 'I returned to AWS as Chief AI & Technology Officer in 2026, after almost 15 years here earlier in my career and most recently leading commercial technology and innovation at PwC.'
Werner Vogels, Amazon's CTO of ~two decades, delivered his final re:Invent closing keynote on Dec. 4, 2025, saying 'This is my final re:Invent keynote' while adding he is not leaving Amazon.

IT Brew reported (Nov. 5, 2026) that Pedram Rezaei, a 20+ year Microsoft veteran most recently in Microsoft's Superintelligence AI division, joined AWS in October 2026; the report characterizes the move as 'to become CTO,' but says his work will focus on Amazon Quick and Kiro per Swami Sivasubramanian's memo.
Pedram Rezaei's own LinkedIn profile lists his position as 'Distinguished Engineer / VP at Amazon Web Services (AWS),' not CTO — casting doubt on the report that he holds the AWS-wide CTO title.
A January 2026 leaked AWS org chart still showed Werner Vogels as 'VP and CTO' among CEO Matt Garman's direct reports — he was the incumbent CTO before Wood's 2026 appointment.
